tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// mukhāgamashshatapatrodghaṭaṇasyahanumadyaṃnāmashrīkṛṣṇayamāriṣaṇmukhikasuraikabiṃshatimaṇḍalasyasādhanaṃbidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po gdong drug lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs zhal lung 'dab brgya phye ba'i 'gram chang zhes bya ba bzhugs// mkha' khyab chos sku 'pho bral rdo rje'i mtshan nyid las// ma 'gags rigs drug gdul byar rjes gzung gdong drug 'jigs// pha rol son drug rnam dag phyag rdzogs srid zhi'i mtha'// bdud bzhir bcas gnon bla ma dus dgra'i mgon pos skyongs// bde chen snying po 'dzin pa'i grong khyer chen po'i dbus// gang zhig 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rtsen pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// mi man rigs can rgyud kyi sgrib pa bag la nyal// zad par za byed ye shes gsus che gshin rje'i dgra// grub thabs rgyal ba rgyal sras zhal lung mtshar sdug ma'i// rnal 'byor rnam bzhi'i 'gram chang skyugs pa dad brtson ldan// legs smin ba ku la yi snod du lhung ba na// dngos grub ci 'dod 'dab stong 'grol ba'i ngo mtshar dbye// de'ang 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ gshin rje'i gshed gdong drug pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la gnyis te/ sngon du 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la'ang gsum ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o zhes pa'i bar spyi ltar bya'o// gnyis pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs padma sogs nas shel sgong dag pa ltar gyur zhes pa'i bar pha rgyud spyi ltar ro// gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang por bsod nams tshogs bsags ni/ rang skad cig gis zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i snying gar a las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i dbu la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas brgyan pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa la/

thal mo sbyar la/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥzhes pas bla ma la phyag bya/ na mo ya mānta ka maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥzhes pas yi dam la phyag byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya mānta ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum brjod/ spro na/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs rigs lnga'i sdom gzung yang lan gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med pa bzhi bsgom mo// gnyis pa ye shes tshogs bsags ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom mo// dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis te/ rten srung 'khor gzhal yas khang bcas bsgom pa/ brten pa rnal 'byor bzhi bsgom pa'o// dang po la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i dbus su padma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i saṃ las rdo rje saṃ gyis mtshan pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdeng kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ljang ser gru bzhi zur bzhir rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/

de'i steng du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa lte ba la bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ padma dang nyi ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang nag pa'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus yongs su bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas mdzes par byas pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i dbus su rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ shar dang mtshams bzhi dang grwa bzhi phyi nang rnams su padma zla ba'i gdan/ lho dang nub dang byang dang sgo bzhir padma dang nyi ma'i gdan bsam mo// gnyis pa brten pa rnal 'byor bzhi bsgom pa ni/ rgyud las/ dang por bsgom pa rnal 'byor te// gnyis pa rjes su rnal 'byor yin// gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor te// bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po'o// zhes pa ltar bzhi las/

dang por rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ ā ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje tho ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes su bsam ste/ yig cha phyi mar zla ba dang nyi ma gnyis la ā li kā lis mtshan pa byung yang*/ slob dpon de ba ā ka ra tsand+ras mdzad pa'i gzhung las ma byung bas so// oṃ badzra muṅga ra ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung*/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ slar 'dus nas gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de yongs su gyur pa las chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab zhal gnyis dang steng zhal nag po zhes pa nas/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sogs nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gsal gdab bo// gnyis pa rjes su rnal 'byor ni/ yab yum thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang*/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis sems can thams cad bkug ste zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'od du zhu/ yum gyi mkhar bab pa'i thig le las gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs su gyur pa sbyor mtshams nas spros pa snod dag pa'i gzhal yas khang rnams su bkod/

slar yang snyoms par zhugs pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar zhu ba yum gyi mkhar bab pas rjes su chags pa'i mes yab yum gnyis kyang 'od du zhu nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig le'i rnam par gyur/ thig le de las sa rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi 'phros nas glus bskul pa ni/ thugs rje'i khro bo rje btsun nyid bzhengs la// sa gsum mtha' dag rmongs pa sol mdzod cig /jo bo sems ni g.yengs so bdud bzhi las// rnam par rgyal ba'i rje btsun nyid bzhengs shig /'jig rten mgron gnyer stong nyid bzhugs sam ci// rje btsun 'jig rten bsod nams kyis bzhengs shig /byang chub rang bzhin 'jig rten mgron gnyer nas// khyod ni stong nyid sems shing ci ste bzhugs// zhes bskul nas lha mo de rnams thig le la thim par bsam mo// de nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i phyir/ thig le de dum bu gnyis su gyur te/ 'og gi thig le maṃ las ma he nag po khro zhing dregs pa dang bcas pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rwa dang rmig pa rno ba lce glog ltar 'gyur ba'i steng du/ thig le steng ma hūm̐ las tho ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing nag zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal nag po drag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab zhal gnyis dang steng zhal nag po/ zhal thams cad drag cing rngams la khro gnyer bsdus pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na rdo rje tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang gtun shing*/ tha ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

zhabs mdun ma gnyis rdo rje skyil krung*/ rgyab ma bzhi'i g.yas gnyis bskum zhing g.yon gnyis brkyang bas ma he'i steng du gshin rje pho mo mnan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ seng ge'i pags pas stod g.yogs shing*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas yab dang lhan cig snyoms par 'jug pa gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung ngo*// gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la āḥyis mtshan pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ snyoms par zhugs pas lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang*/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yum gyi mkhar bab pa skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsam/ de nas rang rang gi sngags kyis so so'i gdan gyi steng du spros te rim gyis gsal gdab pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥbi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/

chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ slar gcig tu 'dus/ rang nyid phyi'i gtso bo'i snying gar thim pas rang nyid zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug dang ldan pa sogs nas/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas yab dang lhan cig snyoms par 'jug pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar brjod pas gsal gdab/ oṃ dzi na dzika swā hā/ mkha' nang gi gti mug rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ slar gcig tu 'dus/ 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ gti mug rdo rje dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ ratna dhṝka swā hā/ mkha' nang gi ser sna rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ slar gcig tu 'dus/ lho rtsibs kyi gdan la/ ser sna rdo rje ser po/ g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du 'og ma thams cad la 'gre zhing*/ oṃ ā ro lika swā hā/ 'dod chags rdo rje spros/ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes la bkod/ slar gcig tu 'dus/ nub rtsibs kyi gdan la/ 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ g.yas padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ pradzñā dhṛka swā hā/ phrag dog rdo rje spros/ phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ slar gcig tu 'dus/ byang rtsibs kyi gdan la/ phrag dog rdo rje ljang gu/ g.yas ral gri 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pa thams cad dril bu 'dzin cing rab tu khros pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/

seng ge'i pags pas stod g.yogs shing*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ lo tsā ni hūm̐/ sa rdo rje ma spros/ sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med pa la bkod/ me'i rtsibs kyi gdan la/ sa rdo rje ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ oṃ mā ma kī traṃ/ chu rdo rje ma spros/ chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med pa/ srin po'i rtsibs kyi gdan la/ chu rdo rje ma ser mo/ g.yas rin po che/ oṃ paṇḍa rā hrīḥ me rdo rje ma spros/ me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba tshad med pa/ rlung gi rtsibs kyi gdan la/ me rdo rje ma dmar mo g.yas padma/ oṃ tā rā aḥ rlung rdo rje ma spros/ rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms tshad med pa la/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs kyi gdan la/ rlung rdo rje ma ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ bzhi ka'ang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o// oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥrdo rje lcags kyu ma spros/ phung po'i bdud bcom/ dad pa'i stobs la bkod/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ rdo rje zhags pa spros/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs la/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ser po g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ rdo rje lcags sgrog spros/ 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ dran pa'i stobs la/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po/ g.yas lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ badzra ā be sha hoḥ rdo rje dril bu spros/ lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ ting 'dzin gyi stobs la/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ljang gu/

glu byang gi me long zhes gsungs/ g.yas dril bu zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ bzhi ka'ang g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang sogs gong gi rigs bzhi ltar brjod/ oṃ badzra lā sya hūm̐/ sgeg mo spros/ ser sna'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la/ slar 'dus nang gi grwa bzhi'i mer sgeg mo dkar mo snyems pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dkur brten pa/ oṃ badzra mā le traṃ/ phreng ba ma spros/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dri ma sbyangs/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ srin por phreng ba ma ser mo/ phyag gnyis kyis phreng ba/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ rdo rje glu ma spros/ khong khro'i dri ma sbyangs/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la/ rlung du rdo rje glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang*/ oṃ badzra nṛ tya aḥ rdo rje gar ma spros/ le lo'i dri ma sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ dbang ldan du rdo rje gar ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis spyi bor gar bskor zhing 'gying ba/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ bdug pa ma spros/ rnam g.yeng gi dri ma sbyangs/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ phyi'i grwa bzhi'i mer rdo rje bdug pa ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis bdug spos/ oṃ badzra puṣpe traṃ/ rdo rje me tog ma spros/ shes rab 'chal pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ srin por rdo rje me tog ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ oṃ badzra dī pe hṝḥ rdo rje mar me ma spros/ smon lam log pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ rlung du rdo rje mar me ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis mar me/ oṃ badzra gandhe aḥmakha' nang gi rdo rje dri chab ma spros/ sems can thams cad kyi thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod/

slar gcig tu 'dus/ dbang ldan du 'khod pa ni rdo rje dri chab ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis dri'i byugs pa 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhi ba dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa spros/ ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ dag pa lha'i gzhal med khang gdan dang bcas par bsgyur/ slar gcig tu 'dus/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa la thim/ mkha' nang gi srung ba'i 'khor lo spros/ sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs bcom/ bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gshin rje'i gshed nag po zhal drug pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥzhes dang*/ phyag rgya ni/ lag ngar gnyis ni bsnol byas nas// mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul byas te// se gol brdab cing bsdu bar bya// zhes 'byung ba ltar gyis spyan drangs la/ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥbarjod pas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil 'bul ba ni/ oṃ hṝḥṣṭī bi kṛtā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ pra wa ra satkā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod la/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ā be sha hoḥ zhes sgo ba bzhi'i phyag rgya kun rig ltar te dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas par bsam mo// skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rgyud gzhung gnyis kar/ dbang sgrubs stong pa nyid bya ste// snying po'i ming gi yi ge yis// rigs kyi phyag rgya ldan pa yi// sku rnams nges par bskyed pas so// zhes pa'i don te/

lha thams cad kyi mig tu kṣiṃ las sa'i snying po dkar po/ rna bar dzrīṃ las phyag na rdo rje nag po/ snar khaṃ las nam mkha'i snying po ser po/ khar gaṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po/ dpral bar kṣaṃ las sgrib pa rnam sel ljang gu/ snying gar paṃ las kun tu bzang po sngon po ste skye mched drug sbyong byed do// spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje nag po rnams bskyed la/ de dag gi thugs kar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsams la/ de rnams las 'od 'phros sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi lha rnams spyan drangs/ gnas gsum du bcug nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsītta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal gzung ngo*// de nas phyag rgya bzhi las/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni lha thams cad kyi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' so so'i sa bon gnas pa'i mthar snying pos bskor bar bsams la/ rgyud las/ lag gnyis thal mo ngos sbyar te// gung mo'i rtsa ba'i tshigs gnyis la// mthe bong nges par sbyar bar bya// mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab rtser sbyar// 'di ni dam tshig phyag rgya ste// snying ga dpral ba lkog ma dang*// spyi bor byin gyis brlab par bya// zhes pa ltar gyi phyag rgyas snying ga dpral ba lkog ma spyi bo rnams su gtugs te/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ a dhi tiṣṭha swa māṃ/ zhes lan bzhir brjod do// chos rgya ni/ lha rnams kyi lce'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po gdengs pa'i lte bar so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ phyag chen ni/ rgyud las/ gzhan yang rdo rje sems ma sogs// phyag rgyas dbang bskur dbu rgyan brtag

/ces pa'i don lha thams cad gsal bar dmigs nas/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ satwa badzri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nyid las gung mo gnyis kyi tshigs dang po bcag la/ mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo gung mo'i tshigs bar par btsugs pas rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgya dpral bar bzhag ste/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzri a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ sems ma rdo rje ma yis gung mo gnyis kyi tshigs bar pa bcag pa rin po che 'dra ba byas rin chen ma'i rgya rna ltag g.yas su bzhag ste/ oṃ ratna badzri a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ de nyid las sor mo padma'i myu gu ltar byas la/ gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa padma 'dra ba chos kyi rdo rje ma'i rgya ltag par bzhag ste/ oṃ dharma badzri a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ sems ma rdo rje ma las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu btsugs pa las kyi rdo rje ma'i rgya rna ltag g.yon du bzhag ste/ oṃ karma badzri a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ zhes pas gtso bo'i gnas de rnams su mi bskyod pa/ rnam snang*/ rin 'byung*/ 'od med/ don grub rnams dang 'khor rnams la phyag rgya phyogs bzhir bstan te/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzri nas karma badzri a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥzhes pa'i bar brjod la/ shar dang shar lho ba la rnam snang*/ lho dang lho nub pa la rin 'byung*/ nub dang nub byang ba la 'od dpag med/ byang dang byang shar ba la don grub kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra tu ṣya hoḥzhes pas thams cad la dar gyi cod paṇa bcing bar bsam mo// las rgya ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba argha'i snod ltar byas te/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon dang*/ khu tshur las mdzub mo dang mthe bos me tog blangs la/ gung mo la sogs pa rim gyis brkyang ste/ oṃ pra wa ra satkā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās zhabs bsil/

oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dī pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai bi dye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nyer spyod kyi mchod pa dang*/ oṃ badzra lā sya hūm̐ nas gandhe aḥzhes pa'i bar lha mo brgyad so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod cing*/ kye kye gshin rje'i gshed nag po// bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin// khyod mthong kho bo rnam par 'jigs// bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs// khyod kyis gar mdzad sa stengs dang*// sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo// mig sman ltar gnag khro bo yi// gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs lags// sku lus sbom thung nag pa ste// rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul pa// rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis btud// gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che// hrīḥṣṭ+rī'i gsang sngags dag gis khyod// sa gsum po yi 'khrul pa sel// thugs rje'i khro bo rje btsun khyod// gar mdzad 'gro ba yongs la gzigs// oṃ sarba ta thā ga twa pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ lha mo rnams kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i// zhe sdang gshin rje rdo rje ni// spros med nam mkha' lta bu las// snying rje'i thabs kyis skur sprul pa// ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa'i// dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud// gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa yi// gti mug gshin rje rdo rje ni// skye med don rtogs ngang nyid las// thabs kyi sprul pa'i skur bstan pa// 'jigs byed drag po'i cha lugs can// zla ba nya 'dra khyod la 'dud// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yi// ser sna gshin rje rdo rje ni// 'dzin pa po las grol ba yi// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor sprul// gter 'chang ser sna 'grol mdzad pa// btso ma gser 'dra khyod la 'dud// chags pas ma lus dpa' mdzad pa'i// 'dod chags gshin rje rdo rje ni// skye med rnam dag chos dbyings las// khams gsum dag byed khro bor sprul// ma chags spyan ldan thugs rje can// bandhu lta bu'i sku la 'dud// shes rab thabs ldan he ru ka

/phrag dog gshin rje rdo rje ni// rnam rtog dpe dang bral ba las// thugs rjes sprul pa'i khro bo ni// 'gro don brtson pa'i ral gri can// sna tshogs mdog can khyod la 'dud// thams cad bskyed pa'i lha mo che// dbang mo lta bur sgyur mdzad pa// khams gsum gzigs pa'i spyan dang ldan// rnam snang can gyis bdud bzhi 'joms// bde ba chen pos rtag tu dgyes// ye shes spyan ldan khyod la 'dud// kun sdud lha mo rin po che// bdag rtog skyon las nges grol yang*// dus gsum bde gshegs bdag gir byed// rin chen tog can mdzes pa yi// don dam thugs chud 'khor ba sel// ma lus rigs kyi bdag la 'dud// 'dus byas ma lus sreg byed pa// rnam rtog zhi ba'i rang bzhin las// khams gsum ma lus sgrol bar byed// 'od dpag med kyis rab mdzes pa// ma chags phyag na bsnams pa yi// phrin las dag byed can la 'dud// thugs rje g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can// 'jig rten gsum dag sgrol bar byed// gnyis med bde chen ngang nyid las// phrin las sgrub pa'i rang bzhin can// btang snyoms bzhugs pas 'gro ba 'dul// kun tu las kyi rgyal la 'dud// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i phyir/ dngos su thod pa'i nang du chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba yod dam med na bsams kyang rung ste/ nang mchod/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i steng du āḥlas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rakta/ nub byang du shu las byang sems/ byang shar du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/

dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du rdo rje tho ba mgo thur du blta ba/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu/ rlangs pas rdo rje tho ba la phog de lhung nas dkrugs te zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dngul chu'i mdog ltar dkar zhing bsil bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rī wi kṛ sogs lha thams cad kyi sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas lce la bzhag ste myangs pas/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod la/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid mnyam par bzhag ste bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la bsdus/ de ye shes sems dpa' la/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ la/ de'ang nā da la bsdus te mthar 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par gzhag go /sngags bzla ba ni/ 'od gsal du mnyam par bzhag pa las/ slar yang rang gshin rje'i gshed yab yum du bzhengs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa sngar ltar gsal ba dmigs la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros/ yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal dang mkha' gnyis brgyud de 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel zhing rgyas par byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ sngags bzla/ de bzhin du phrin las bzhi sgrub pa'i dmigs pa rnams kyang spyi ltar bya zhing*/

sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa gtso bor bzla'o// lha so so'i sngags ni/ oṃ dzi na dzika swā hā/ gti mug rdo rje'i 'o// oṃ ratna dhṛka swā hā/ ser sna rdo rje'i 'o// oṃ ā ro lika swā hā/ 'dod chags rdo rje'i 'o// oṃ pra dzñā dhṛka swā hā/ phrag dog rdo rje'i 'o// oṃ lo tsa ni hūm̐/ sa rdo rje ma'i 'o// oṃ mā ma kī traṃ/ chu rdo rje ma'i 'o// oṃ paṇḍa rā hrīḥ me rdo rje ma'i 'o// oṃ tā rā aḥ rlung rdo rje ma'i 'o// oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ā be sha hoḥ rdo rje lcags kyu sogs sgo ba bzhi'i 'o// oṃ badzra lā sye hūm̐/ oṃ badzra mā le traṃ/ oṃ badzra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badzra nṛ tya aḥ rdo rje sgeg mo sogs nang gi lha mo bzhi'i 'o// oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe traṃ/ oṃ badzra dī pe dhrīḥ oṃ badzra gandhe aḥ rdo rje bdug pa sogs phyi'i lha mo bzhi'i ste lha mo so so'i sngags rnams gtso bo'i bcu cha la sogs pa ji ltar rigs par bzla'o// phreng ba ni mi dang glang po che la sogs pa'i rus pa las byas pa'i phreng ba/ bsnyen pa'i dus su phreng rdog re re nas gshin rje'i gshed du bskyed la/ sgrub pa'i dus su mi mgo khrag 'dzag par bsam zhes rje btsun rin po ches dgra nag gi sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni gtso bo la 'bum phrag bcu bzhi yin la/ slob dpon de ba ā ka ra tsand+ras/ bye ba tshang bar bzlas pa yis// rab 'byams las ni mi 'grub pa// med de thams cad de yis 'grub// 'bum dang sa ya bzlas pas kyang*// phra mo'i las rnams 'grub par byed// ces gsungs so// yang slob dpon de nyid kyis/ 'gro ba'i don la 'gro bsams te// mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba bya// de nyid gsum mthar muḥldan pas// rang bzhin gshegs shing bskyed pa bsdu// bzod par gsol dang gsol ba gdab// bsngo ba smon lam gdab par bya// zhes dang*/

rje btsun rin po ches kyang*/ thun gtong bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ bdag gi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang bar byas la zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don ni/ thun las ldang bar 'dod na/ bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ gong las rgya'i skabs ltar mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar sgeg sogs brgyad dang*/ kye kye gshin rje'i gshed nag po sogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan sogs kyis bstod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi lha thams cad la phul bar bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭī sogs nas lha thams cad kyi sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar nga rgyal gzung ba'i sngags rnams dor ba min pa gzhan 'dra bar byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mdun du byon par bsams la/ de la mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ ma 'byor pa dang zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes dngos grub blangs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ ye shes

rje btsun rin po ches/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis rang la bsdu bar gsungs so// pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa spyod lam gyi dang por gtor ma ni/ gtor ma bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis gnas nas gshin rje gshed zhal drug pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes dang*/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa du ma spros pas/ phyogs skyong bcu bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa bkug par bsam zhing lcags kyu'i phyag rgya phyogs bcur bskor zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rī wi kri tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sarba duṣṭ+rāṃ ind+rā dī na sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas/ dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang*// dbang ldan me lha srin pa rlung lha dang*// zla ba nyi ma tshangs pa sa lha mo// thag zangs ris dang nye dbang tshogs bdag sogs// phyogs skyong 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams// byon nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs bcur bzhugs// zhes sam/ rgyas pa la mos pas khos bos dkyil chog sta gon skabs su bris pa ltar sku mdog zhal phyag bcas gsal gdab bo// gnyis ka ltar yang*/ rang gi snying ga nas gshin rje'i gshed lag na phur bu thogs pa spros te/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi spyi bo nas phur bus btab par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rī sogs yi ge bcu bzhi pa sngon du 'gro ba'i mthar/ sarba duṣṭ+rāṃ ind+ra ā dī na sa pa ri wā ra badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod kyin spyi bo nas phur bus btab pas/ grub pa'i bcud len grub pa bzhin du/ thams cad kyang gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gyur par bsam/

de nas mchod yon dang zhabs bsil gyis mchod nas/ gtor ma phul ba gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye nas/ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥsogs dang i daṃ ba liṃ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swā hā/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la phul/ oṃ ind+rā ya hrīḥya mā yaṣṭ+rī/ wa ru ṇā ya wi/ ku be rā ya kṛ/ ī shwa rā ya ta/ agna ye ā/ nair ṛ tyā ya na/ wa ya we na/ tsand+rā ya hūm̐/ arkā ya hūm̐/ brahma ṇā ya phaṭa/ ba su dhā rya ya phaṭa/ bi ma tsi trā ya swā/ sarba bhū te bhyo hā/ ha ha ha hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swā hā/ zhes pas phyogs skyong 'khor bcas la dbul/ slar yang me tog sogs kyis mchod/ snying po'i yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'i nang mchod phul la/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod sogs kyis bstod/ gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// dkon mchog gsum la smod pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa dang*// dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang*// 'gro yongs 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs 'di// ngan song gsum du mngon par 'gro// thugs rjes bsgral ba'i dus la bab// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal las// tshe 'di nyid las bral bar mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ yang de tsam mi nus na/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gsung rab las 'byung ba ltar te/ rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor steng gi cha la/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor zhing*/ 'og gi cha la 'jig rten skyong ba bcu bzhi/

'jig rten pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis so sor gdan 'bul/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rī sogs dang*/ i daṃ ba liṃ bakṣa ya bhakṣa ya hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis bstabs la/ gong bzhin mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sangs rgyas rnams ni kun sdud cing*// sangs rgyas kun gyi mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod// gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs phrin las bcol bas/ lha rnams kyis ha ha hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mnyes nas dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ de nas yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ 'di dag ni gtor ma 'bring bsdus kyi lugs ltar byas pa yin la/ gtor chog rgyas pa ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ dgra nag gi skabs su bshad pa ltar na/ gtor mgron dgug pa na'ang*/ oṃ hṝḥṣṭ+rī sogs yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i rjes su/ sarba duṣṭ+rān ind+rā ya sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes brgya byin dang*/ de bzhin du yi ge bcu bzhi pa dang*/ sarba duṣṭ+rān kun la sbyar ba'i ya mā yas gshin rje nas/ bi ma tsi trā yas thag zangs ris kyi bar rnams la re re bzhin du bkug pa dang*/ dbang bsdus gnyis la yi ge bcu bzhi pa dang*/ sarba duṣṭān sa pā ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes so so'i mtshan ma smos par sdang ba thams cad ces spyi khyab tu/ phyogs skyong bco lnga po dus gcig la dgug pa dang*/ de bzhin du phur gdab la'ang*/ sarba duṣkān sa pa ri wā ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐/ zhes pas dus gcig la btab pas/ thams cad kyang gshin rje'i gshed zhal gsum phyag drug par bsgyur bar bzhed do// de la phyis kyi bu ston la sogs pa ni/

sarba duṣṭān ind+ri ā dī na sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa/ bod skad du dbang po la sogs pa 'khor bcas zhes sogs 'khor du bsdu bar mdzad do// des na phyogs skyong bcu'am bco lnga gang yin yang*/ rgyas pa na dbang po dang gshin rje sogs so so'i mtshan sngags can gyis dgug pa'am/ de ltar mi nus na/ sarba duṣṭān sa pa ri wā ra zhes spyi khyab tu byas pas btub la/ de ltar yang min par ind+ra zhes dbang po'i ming smos pa tsam gyis/ ā dī na zhes pa la sogs kyi skad dod 'di ma chad pa bya dgos te/ 'di med na dbang po/ gcig pu las gzhan mi thus pas/ phyis su yig skyon zhugs sam/ sgros ngan rgyun 'byams kyi rjes su zhugs pa zhig yin nam snyam mo// gtor ma'i cho ga'o// de nas bdag gi mig tu sa snying sogs kyis bsrungs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gshin rje'i gshed dpal grub gyur nas// zhes sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /ces sogs dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa nas/ ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /ces pa'i bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// spyod lam gyi gnas skabs kun du/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku snang stong dbyer med dang*/ sgra grag pa thams cad kyang sngags kyi sgra grag stong dbyer med dang*/ sems kyi dran rtog thams cad rig stong dbyer med kyi rnam rol du shes pa dang*/ khrus byed pa'i tshe/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing khrus bya'o// kha zas kyi tshe/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ phud bla ma dang gshin rje'i gshed rab lhar gsal ba'i snying gar bzhugs pa dang*/ lto bar 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs bsams la/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du longs spyad/ nyal ba'i tshe snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis snod bcud lha dang bcas pa 'od gsal du bsdus te nyal lo// ldang ba'i tshe stong nyid de'i ngang las skad cig gis rang lha'i skur gyur pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis snod bcud gsal btab nas/

snang ba thams cad lhar dmigs la/ kun du spyod pa thams cad lha'i nga rgyal dang*/ longs spyod pa thams cad lhas lha mchod par bsams la longs spyad/ de ltar dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas sgrub pa la nan tan du byas na bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ro// de dag kyang dpal sa skya'i rje btsun chen po'i gsung las/ de las 'dir bla ma rnams kyi man ngag gis nag po rgyud gsum po gcig tu bsdebs nas/ mngon par rtogs pa gcig tu byed pa yin te/ de'ang dgra nag po 'di nas mngon par rtogs pa thams cad kyi gzhi ma tshang ba med par ston/ gdong drug pa nas 'khrul 'khor gsal bar ston cing*/ gzhan rnams kyang ma tshang ba kha skong*/ rtog pa bdun pa nas gsang sngags gsal bar ston cing*/ gzhan rnams kyang ma tshang ba kha skong ngo*// de ltar na phan tshun gcig na mi gsal ba gcig gis gsal bar bya zhing*/ mngon par rtogs pa rnams lag tu longs par 'chad pa yin mod kyi/ rang gi mngon par rtogs pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ rang rang gi rgyud kyi steng du so sor shes par bya'o zhes 'byung ngo*// smras pa/ gshin rje mthar byed rim gnyis rnal 'byor pas// gnas skabs phrin las rnam bzhir dbang 'byor zhing*// mthar thug yon tan bsam mi khyab bdag gi /go sar ring min bgrod pa'i sgrub thabs byas// rnal 'byor rnam bzhi 'khor bcas rgyud gsum gyi// nges bstan spyi 'gros shes pa'i gnam ru bdungs// khyad chos drang po'i nyan phrag btang ba 'dis// mkhas rlom bden min smra ba'i gnad la 'bigs// dge bas 'bras bu'i theg par skye bo rnams// mgron du gnyer byas mtshan rtog sgrib pa'i dgra// mthar byed ye shes lnga ldan gzugs rnam can// dus dgra'i dbang po'i go 'phang dgod par shog /ces gshin rje'i gshed nag po gdong drug lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs zhal lung 'dab brgya phye ba'i 'gram chang zhes bya ba 'di ni/

dpal sa skya'i phrin las kyi snang chen 'gyed pa'i mdo sngags rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bzang po pa'i gsung bskul snga phyir stsal ngor gong du smos pa'i 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ma'i bzhed pa nyams su blang bde bar/ bande tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i ming du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder btags pas/ lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs ba gam du bris pa rdo rje theg pa'i bstan par phan par gyur cig/ ༈ /gdong drug dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje'i dgra gdong drug pa/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen nag po pa/ slob dpon bha de ba/ slob dpon dam pa/ slob dpon de wa pa/ grub chen dze tā ri/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ bla ma rje btsun rga lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge dpal ldan seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ dharma ka ra ya ta/ sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan/ rin chen dpal grub/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ rig 'dzin rgyal po/ chos rig rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams dpal 'byor/ byang gling pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje btsun tshul khrims bkra shis/ dad sgrol rin chen rgya mtsho/ chos rje kun dga' bsam 'grub/ mtshungs med byams pa rab brtan/ gong dkar ba kun dga' dar rgyas/ bka' drin zla bral sangs rgyas bzang po pa/ des bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis legs par nos so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
